turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My wife, do not worry. The eldest son will marry soon and we will see to it that all is well. You must rest and not speak of such things.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My husband, I know I must not worry you, but I must see my son married before I leave this world. It is my last wish, and I ask you to help make it so.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, you must rest. I will ensure that the eldest son marries soon and that everything is taken care of as you wish. Do not burden yourself with such thoughts.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My husband, I know you mean to do as I wish, but my heart is heavy with worry. I beg you to hasten the marriage so I may see it with my own eyes before I am gone.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest. Father will see to it that everything is done as you wish. I will do my best to make you proud.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, rest assured. I will make sure the eldest son marries quickly and that your wishes are fulfilled. Do not fear for our future, for I will see to it.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you mean to do as I ask, my husband, but my time grows short. I beg you to speak with my son and his new wife to hasten the preparations.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will speak with them this very day, my dear. Do not trouble yourself with worries. Rest now, and know that I will see your wishes come true.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My heart is at peace knowing you will see to it, my husband. Please, speak to them now and bring my wish to pass.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: My lord, my lady, I will attend to the preparations at once. Please, rest easy knowing your wishes will be carried out.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will speak with them now, my dear. Do not worry, for all will be well.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, my son and his wife. I feel your care and it brings comfort to my heart. Please, do as my husband asks.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will do as you bid, my lord and lady. May the gods watch over you and bring peace to your hearts.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My time is short, and I must see my son married before I leave this earth. Please, hurry, but do it with care.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please do not worry. I will marry soon, as you wish. Your health is our greatest concern.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you will, my son. But time is not patient, and I fear it will take what it wants without waiting for my consent.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Father, we must do everything in our power to make this happen. I will find a suitable wife quickly, to ease Mother's mind.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear wife, do not despair. We will arrange the marriage swiftly and with all the care it deserves. You shall see your wish fulfilled.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Hurry, but not hastily. I must see my grandson born, a legacy to carry on our bloodline. Let us not rush and ruin what is sacred.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, Father, I will begin the search for a suitable wife immediately. I shall honor your wishes and bring peace to your heart.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
